name: The Creepy Carnival

features.name: Star Spin bar
features.description: Stores high-symbol wins for a bonus spin.

review:
A spooky fairground on 5x3 that's gentler than it looks. Three or more scatters start free spins that can retrigger up to 50 spins.

The clever bit is the Star Spin bar: every base-game win on high symbols gets stored, and later it awards a free spin with extra wilds using those symbols. Medium volatility, 1,595x max. Dark look, easy ride.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
